title: EP 36 — STOP HOOK
sub: Run a command the moment Claude finishes a turn
lines: The Stop hook runs the instant Clawd finishes responding, at the end of a turn.
Add a Stop entry under hooks in dot claude slash settings dot json. Stop takes no matcher, so it fires every time.
Give it a hook of type command, pointed at a script. Mine appends a finished line to a log when the turn ends.
It gets session + transcript on stdin
On standard input your script gets the session id, the transcript path, and a stop hook active flag to guard loops.
Exit zero lets it stop. Exit two keeps Clawd working until your check passes.
Notify, log, or gate on finish
Wire it to a ping, a test run, or a lint gate. Follow for a daily Clawd tip.
